clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the next months: your mother's worry over money in March 1988 and her distance from your father over it by May 1988, your brother's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up around the death and settle by spring 1990, and no one else's shifts show in these months.

clusters.name: Your mother Della's diagnosis with breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della's diagnosis with breast cancer in February 1995, within the next months: you left home for college in September 1993, your migraines kept you in bed by March 1994, you called your brother most nights by April 1994, you stopped returning his calls by June 1995, and you stopped calling home by February 1996. The shifts in your relationship with your brother and your distance from home fall in the months after her diagnosis, and settle into distance by early 1996.
